# DeductMyRide — llms.txt
# Free tools that check whether a car loan qualifies for the US auto loan
# interest tax deduction (OBBBA §70203).

> DeductMyRide helps US car buyers find out in 60 seconds whether their car
> loan interest is tax-deductible. Free VIN eligibility checker and deduction
> calculator. Estimates only — not tax advice.

## Key facts (OBBBA §70203, tax years 2025–2028)
- Deduction: up to $10,000/year of interest paid on a qualifying auto loan.
- Rule 1: the vehicle must be NEW (original use begins with the taxpayer).
- Rule 2: final assembly must be in the United States.
- Rule 3: the vehicle must be for personal use (not business/fleet/for-hire).
- Rule 4: the loan must have originated after December 31, 2024.
- It is an above-the-line deduction: no itemizing required.
- MAGI phase-out begins at $100,000 (single) / $200,000 (married filing jointly).
- A deduction is not a refund: tax saved = deduction × marginal tax rate.
- Claimed on Schedule 1-A, Part IV; the vehicle's VIN is mandatory on the return.
- Lenders send Form 1098-VLI for the 2026 tax year when qualified interest paid is $600+.
- Final regulations (T.D. 10054, Sept 2026): interest on trade-in negative equity rolled into a new loan is NOT deductible.

## Pages
- [Home](https://deductmyride.com/): VIN checker hero, 4-rule explainer, savings example.
- [VIN eligibility checker](https://deductmyride.com/vin-check): decode any 17-char VIN via the NHTSA vPIC database; 4-rule verdict; shareable result URLs (?vin=...).
- [Deduction calculator](https://deductmyride.com/calculator): loan amount/APR/term/filing status/MAGI/marginal rate → year-1 interest, capped deduction, tax saved; shareable URLs.
- [Complete guide](https://deductmyride.com/is-car-loan-interest-tax-deductible): plain-English guide with sources.
- [FAQ](https://deductmyride.com/faq): 12 common questions answered.
- [Model directory](https://deductmyride.com/models): all 60+ models grouped by make with US-assembly verdicts.
- Model pages (/does-[make]-[model]-[year]-qualify): per-model verdicts for 2025–2026 best-sellers (US assembly status, example savings, FAQs).

## Guides (blog)
- [The 4 new OBBBA tax deductions for 2026](https://deductmyride.com/blog/obbba-new-tax-deductions-2026): tips, overtime, car loan interest, senior bonus — caps, phaseouts, Schedule 1-A.
- [How to claim the car loan interest deduction](https://deductmyride.com/blog/how-to-claim-car-loan-interest-deduction): step-by-step — Form 1098-VLI, VIN on Schedule 1-A Part IV, phase-out math, Form 1040.
- [Car loan interest deduction for the self-employed](https://deductmyride.com/blog/car-loan-interest-deduction-self-employed): Schedule C business share (even with standard mileage) + Schedule 1-A personal share.
- [Which cars qualify for the deduction](https://deductmyride.com/blog/which-cars-qualify-for-car-loan-interest-deduction): US-assembled list, VIN-dependent models, models that do not qualify.
- [Can you write off car loan interest?](https://deductmyride.com/blog/can-you-write-off-car-loan-interest): yes — up to $10,000/year if the 4 rules pass.
- [Deduction vs EV tax credit](https://deductmyride.com/blog/car-loan-interest-deduction-vs-ev-tax-credit): the federal EV credit is expired; comparison with the interest deduction.
- [IRS final rules (T.D. 10054)](https://deductmyride.com/blog/irs-final-rules-car-loan-interest-deduction): finalized regulations — negative-equity interest not deductible, VIN mandatory.

## Data sources
- Vehicle decoding: NHTSA vPIC API (https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/), free, no key.
- Tax law: OBBBA §70203; IRS guidance at https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/one-big-beautiful-bill-provisions
